payload.text: Not until the report was published ___ the scale of the problem become clear.
payload.explanation_uz: Not until bilan boshlangan gapda inversiya bo'ladi: yordamchi fe'l (did) ega oldidan keladi.

payload.text: Rarely ___ (I / hear) such a persuasive speech.
payload.explanation_uz: Rarely kabi inkor ma'noli ravish gap boshida kelsa, yordamchi fe'l ega oldiga o'tadi (have I heard).

payload.text: Under no circumstances ___ employees disclose client data. (modal verb)
payload.explanation_uz: Under no circumstances bilan boshlangan gapda inversiya bo'ladi; bu yerda modal fe'l ega oldida turadi.

payload.text: If I had taken that job in Dubai, I ___ (be) living there now.
payload.explanation_uz: Aralash shart gap: o'tgan sharti (had taken) va hozirgi natija (would be).

payload.text: If she weren't so stubborn, she ___ (accept) the offer last week.
payload.explanation_uz: Aralash shart gap: hozirgi doimiy holat (weren't) va o'tgan natija (would have + V3).

payload.text: The committee insisted that he ___ (resign) immediately.
payload.explanation_uz: insist that bilan rasmiy subjunktiv ishlatiladi: fe'l asosiy shaklda (resign), -s qo'shilmaydi.

payload.text: I wish I ___ (not / say) those words yesterday.
payload.explanation_uz: O'tmishdagi pushaymonlik wish + Past Perfect (had + V3) bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.text: It's high time we ___ (address) the issue of funding.
payload.explanation_uz: It's high time + ega + Past Simple: hozirgi zamonda bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan ish haqida.

payload.text: Would you rather he ___ (not / smoke) in the house?
payload.explanation_uz: would rather + boshqa ega bo'lsa, hozirgi/kelasi zamon uchun Past Simple ishlatiladi.

payload.text: What really annoys me ___ the way he never apologises.
payload.explanation_uz: What-cleft gapda 'What ... is ...' tuzilmasi urg'u beradi.

payload.text: It was not until 1990 ___ the company turned a profit.
payload.explanation_uz: It was not until ... that ... tuzilmasi cleft gap bo'lib, vaqtni ta'kidlaydi.

payload.text: The treaty is believed ___ (sign) in secret back in 1842.
payload.explanation_uz: Passiv believed + to have been + V3: o'tmishdagi voqea haqidagi taxmin.

payload.text: She had her passport ___ (steal) while travelling in Rome.
payload.explanation_uz: have + narsa + V3 tuzilmasi: ish boshqa tomonidan bajarilgan yoki boshdan kechirilgan.

payload.text: I'll get the technician ___ (fix) the printer tomorrow.
payload.explanation_uz: get + shaxs + to-infinitive sababiy (causative) tuzilmasi.

payload.text: ___ (finish) her degree two years earlier, she was well qualified for the post.
payload.explanation_uz: Oldingi bajarilgan ish Having + V3 sifatdosh iborasi bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.text: No sooner had we sat down ___ the lights went out.
payload.explanation_uz: No sooner ... than ... qolipi: ikki ketma-ket voqea; inversiya had + ega.

payload.text: She ___ have left yet; her coat is still on the chair.
payload.explanation_uz: O'tmish haqidagi kuchli inkor xulosa can't have + V3 bilan beriladi.

payload.text: I ___ have lent him the money; it was a foolish mistake. (criticising yourself)
payload.explanation_uz: O'tmishdagi xatoga pushaymonlik: shouldn't have + V3.

payload.text: Anyone ___ (wish) to apply must submit the form by Friday.
payload.explanation_uz: Qisqartirilgan nisbiy gap: who wishes o'rniga V-ing (wishing) ishlatiladi.

payload.text: I ___ lock the door; I distinctly remember doing it. (emphatic)
payload.explanation_uz: Tasdiqni kuchaytirish uchun darak gapda yordamchi fe'l (did) + asosiy fe'l ishlatiladi.

payload.text: Little ___ she know that the letter would change her life.
payload.explanation_uz: Little inkor ma'noli ravish sifatida gap boshida inversiyani talab qiladi (did she know).

payload.text: I didn't want to attend the meeting, but I had ___.
payload.explanation_uz: Ellipsis: takrorlanmaslik uchun fe'l tushiriladi, faqat 'to' qoladi (had to).

payload.text: The manager is accountable ___ the board for all decisions.
payload.explanation_uz: accountable to (shaxs) for (narsa): qat'iy predlogli birikma.

payload.text: She took full advantage ___ the opportunity.
payload.explanation_uz: take advantage of: qat'iy predlogli birikma.

payload.text: ___ it not for your help, I would have failed.
payload.explanation_uz: Aralash/3-shart gapda if tushirilganda inversiya: Were it not for = If it were not for.

payload.text: He was reluctant to comply ___ the new regulations.
payload.explanation_uz: comply with: qat'iy predlogli fe'l birikmasi.

payload.text: The ___ (SUFFICIENT) of the evidence led to the case being dismissed.
payload.explanation_uz: So'z yasash: in- old qo'shimchasi va -ency qo'shimchasi bilan ot hosil bo'ladi.

payload.text: Her ___ (RELUCTANT) to speak in public held back her career.
payload.explanation_uz: Sifatdan ot yasash: reluctant -> reluctance (-ant -> -ance).

payload.question: The more she practised, ___ she became.
payload.explanation_uz: The + qiyosiy daraja ..., the + qiyosiy daraja ... qolipi.

payload.question: ___ the weather, we decided to go ahead with the picnic.
payload.explanation_uz: Notwithstanding rasmiy predlog bo'lib, ot oldidan keladi; despite of va in spite noto'g'ri.

payload.question: The sculpture is thought ___ the country last year.
payload.explanation_uz: O'tmishdagi voqea haqidagi passiv: is thought + to have + V3.

payload.question: If he hadn't missed the flight, he ___ in Tokyo now.
payload.explanation_uz: Aralash shart gap: o'tgan sharti (hadn't missed) va hozirgi natija (would be).

payload.question: It is essential that every applicant ___ the form in person.
payload.explanation_uz: essential that bilan subjunktiv: fe'l asosiy shaklda keladi.

payload.question: The man ___ the speech is my uncle.
payload.explanation_uz: Qisqartirilgan nisbiy gap: who is giving o'rniga V-ing (giving).

payload.question: The film was visually stunning. ___, the plot was thin.
payload.explanation_uz: That said qarama-qarshilik bildiruvchi diskurs bog'lovchisi; boshqalari qo'shish yoki sabab ma'nosida.

payload.question: ___ I need is a long holiday.
payload.explanation_uz: What-cleft: What I need is ... tuzilmasi ega vazifasidagi gapni hosil qiladi.

payload.question: She has a real flair ___ languages.
payload.explanation_uz: a flair for: qat'iy predlogli birikma.

payload.question: The proposal met ___ fierce opposition.
payload.explanation_uz: meet with: (qarshilik, muvaffaqiyat) bilan to'qnash kelmoq, qat'iy birikma.

payload.question: Which noun correctly completes the sentence? The ___ of the new law was delayed.
payload.explanation_uz: Fe'ldan ot yasash: implement -> implementation (-ation qo'shimchasi).

payload.question: She regrets ___ the opportunity to study abroad.
payload.explanation_uz: regret + V-ing o'tmishdagi ishga pushaymonlikni bildiradi.

payload.question: He ___ have seen me; he walked straight past.
payload.explanation_uz: O'tmish haqida kuchli inkor xulosa: can't have + V3.

payload.question: He had the builders ___ the wall twice.
payload.explanation_uz: have + shaxs + infinitive (to'siz) sababiy tuzilma: had the builders rebuild.

payload.question: Seldom ___ such dedication.
payload.explanation_uz: Seldom gap boshida kelsa, inversiya bo'ladi: have I seen.

payload.question: He suggested that she ___ a doctor.
payload.explanation_uz: suggest that bilan subjunktiv: fe'l asosiy shaklda keladi.

payload.question: By the time the rescuers arrived, the climbers ___ for two days.
payload.explanation_uz: Boshqa o'tmish payt oldidan davom etgan holat: Past Perfect (had been trapped).
